name: Living Stipple
desc: Thousands of luminous stipple dots swarm and re-cluster across a bold high-contrast fBm density field, streaming along its drifting contours like a breathing pointillist engraving that fills the frame in spectral, ink, gold-dust, blueprint or neon inks.

grain.doc: dot size (bigger, bolder marks at max)

clustering.doc: density contrast: how hard dots pile into bright basins

flow.doc: perpetual contour circulation speed of the dots

warp.doc: domain-warp turbulence of the underlying field

scale.doc: field feature zoom (bigger blobs at max)

style.doc: render philosophy: field-hued bright dots / bold black ink on cream / warm gold-dust on dark / white schematic on blueprint / additive neon duotone
